anchor.source_detail: White Beryl ff.161bff; Moonbeams ff.20a-23a; 4+1+2+5+100+24=136.

source_notes.paraphrase: Mar-ston's fixed natal divination uses 136 pebbles: 4 precious, 1 special, 2 indispensable, 5 unchanging-luck, 100 demon-relational and 24 conclusive-analysis.

anchor.source_detail: Source p140-141; worked example p141.

source_notes.paraphrase: The four precious pebble positions correspond to birth year (king), month (minister), day (soldier), hour (weapon). Their meaning is conditional on subject and contrasting elements, not isolated animal sign alone.
source_notes.verified_against: source text PDF or arXiv HTML on 2026-10-21

anchor.source_detail: Chart 4.1; visual row/O/X mapping should be checked before coding.

source_notes.paraphrase: The printed model iron-sheep birth uses the rows year iron-sheep vs vitality earth, month fire-sheep vs body water, day wood-bird vs destiny iron, hour water-hare vs luck fire; chart displays white/black pebble outcomes.

anchor.source_detail: Chart 4.2; relation categories require definitions and precedence from the full chapter.

source_notes.paraphrase: The special pebble is chosen according to penalty/friend/enemy/identity/mother/son relationship to a constitutional-year category; distinct categories yield different numbers and colors of pebbles.

anchor.source_detail: Book p141; separate query-time forecast from birth-only forecast.

source_notes.paraphrase: At least one of the two indispensable pebbles depends on the hour at which the divination is performed, rather than solely on the birth chart.

anchor.source_detail: Book p142, chart 4.4; parent inputs must be frozen independently, not inferred from subject responses.

source_notes.paraphrase: The unchanging-luck section explicitly uses paternal and maternal information, mother's current trigram and numeric square, and natal month; the father's choice differs for a boy versus a girl.

anchor.source_detail: Book p142, parallel Moonbeams verses p143.

anchor.source_detail: Book printed pp172-174; do not blend mutually inconsistent lookup tables or choose retrospectively.
